immediate_actions.action: Block lots L2402 and L2403 in MES, quarantine all non-shipped panels at fg_buffer, packout_queue, qa_cage.
immediate_actions.reason: The selected trigger runs share low TAL and low peak signals that map to a center-zone heat delivery loss.

immediate_actions.action: Launch 100% AOI plus visual reinspection for affected runs and notify downstream packout that shipped panels need recall screening.
immediate_actions.reason: The dominant defects are wetting-related, so immediate downstream screening is required before any more units move.

immediate_actions.action: Inspect reflow zones 5-7 heater output, blower balance, and rail loading before any restart decision.
immediate_actions.reason: Both trigger runs point to insufficient heat delivery through the center of the profile.

inspection_points: Check zone 5-7 heater feedback versus setpoint.
Confirm center-zone blower circulation is stable across both rails.
Inspect conveyor loading balance and shadowing at the board center mass.
parameter_checks: O2 is not the primary trigger for this incident; do not release only on nitrogen data.
Peak temperature must be at least liquidus + 20.00 C.
TAL must recover to 30.00-60.00 s on the representative thermocouple.
technician_action_card.release_condition: Release only after a confirmation run shows TAL and peak both recovered on the representative thermocouple and quality approves the reinspection results.
